subtitle: Add capabilities to this hub: connectors, voice and more. Installing an extension runs a new program on the hub machine, so you see what it can do and agree before it's installed.
unsupported_title: This hub can't manage extensions here yet
unsupported_detail: Update the hub first. Until then, install and manage them with {command} on the hub machine.
no_db_title: This hub has no database, so extensions can't be installed
no_db_detail: Built-in extensions and those in manager.json still work. Installing, upgrading and uninstalling need the hub connected to Postgres.
list_footer: Fill in settings and secrets in the app under Settings › Extensions. Built-in extensions can't be uninstalled, and those in manager.json can only be changed there. Every step here is recorded in the extension's audit log as "admin page".
empty_detail: Extensions can come from a folder or package on the hub machine, an https link with a sha256, an extension running elsewhere (socket), or an upload here.
needs_setup: Still needs: {items} (fill in under Settings › Extensions in the app)
changes_hub_json: Set in manager.json; change it there
path_hint: A folder on the hub machine (copied in, so later changes to it don't affect the installed one), or a .tar.gz / .zip package.
url_hint: https only, ending in #sha256=<64 hex digits>. The hub checks the download and won't install it if it doesn't match.
remote_hint: The extension runs elsewhere and connects through a unix socket on the hub machine. No files are copied; the manifest comes from the extension.
upgrade_intro: Currently {version}. Pick the new version's package and see what it can do before deciding; settings and secrets are kept.
upload_hint: .tar.gz, .tgz or .zip, up to {mb} MB. Uploads wait in the hub's staging folder and are deleted if not installed within 10 minutes.
more_permissions_title: The new version asks for more permissions
more_permissions_detail: It can do more than what you agreed to before. Review the new items below before deciding; if you don't agree, it isn't upgraded and the old version keeps working.
manifest_only: It's only a manifest: it runs no program and needs no permissions.
unresolved: Can't install yet: {items}. Add them and preview again.
preview_left: This preview is valid for {left}. Installing checks it again: it only installs if the permissions match what you see.
preview_expired: This preview expired. Click Choose another to preview again. Installing checks it again: it only installs if the permissions match what you see.
roll_back_detail: Goes from {from} back to the previous version, {to}. Only one step back; settings and secrets are kept, and permissions return to the old version's.
uninstall_detail: Stops its program and deletes its package, settings and secrets. Connectors it provides are removed from the inbox, knowledge base and assistant. Install it again to use it.
keep_data_detail: {path} stays, so a reinstall can pick up where it left off.
sandbox_default_on: On by default: not from the official marketplace
sandbox_default_off: Off by default: from the official marketplace
sandbox_you_off: Turned off by you · on by default
sandbox_you_on: Turned on by you · off by default
sandbox_proxy_still: Programs that use the egress proxy still reach only allowed addresses.
sandbox_off_note: Sandbox off: {name} can reach any address and read and write the hub user's files.
sandbox_off_body: Without it, the extension can read and write every file the hub user can, and reach any address.
